definitions.explanation: A utensil consisting of a small shallow bowl on a handle, used for eating, stirring, or measuring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}{匙|さじ}→大匙：22527_oosaji⟧⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please add one tablespoon of sugar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|こ}{匙|さじ}→小匙：12435_kosaji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: Measure the medicine with a teaspoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{匙|さじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げた→投げる：01135_nageru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor gave up (on the patient).
examples.notes: [Note: {匙|さじ}を{投|な}げる means 'to throw in the towel, to give up' (originally from doctors giving up on treatment)]

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|こ}{匙|さじ}→小匙：12435_kosaji⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: About half a teaspoon of salt is enough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{匙|さじ}⟦{加減|かげん}→加減：02602_kagen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦しまう→てしまう：03102_teshimau⟧。
examples.english: In cooking, the adjustment of amounts is important — even a small difference can change the flavor.

notes:
{匙|さじ} is a traditional word for spoon. In modern Japanese, ⟦スプーン→スプーン：00891_supuun⟧ is more commonly used for Western-style spoons, while {匙|さじ} is used in cooking measurements and traditional contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{大|おお}{匙|さじ}→大匙：22527_oosaji⟧ (tablespoon, approx. 15ml)
- ⟦{小|こ}{匙|さじ}→小匙：12435_kosaji⟧ (teaspoon, approx. 5ml)
- {匙|さじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧ (to give up, to throw in the towel)
- {匙|さじ}⟦{加減|かげん}→加減：02602_kagen⟧ (seasoning to taste, adjusting amounts)

NOTE: The kanji {匙|さじ} is often written in hiragana in recipes.
